== Summary ==
Players Committee legacy virtual-card slip PDF ''Virtual Block 4: Expanded Universe'' (cover: official text as of 7 December 2009). This is the official <code>VirtualBlock4.pdf</code> that the Committee hosted at res.starwarsccg.org and that is cited on [[Virtual Block 4]]. Throdo also attached this exact file (same SHA-1) to his Players Committee forum post of 10 May 2022, "Original 17 VSet PDFs & Pre-Reset Block PDFs" (post 1376414, forum attachment id 16716).

* '''Date:''' 7 December 2009 (official text date on the cover)
* '''Pages:''' 12

== Source ==
[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf VirtualBlock4.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174331/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]. The archived copy is byte-identical to this file (the SHA-1 of the archived payload matches).
